verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of terminal font, color-scheme or cursor-appearance customization, or of persisting such settings. The mobile cursor evidence covers moving the cursor by long-press and drag, not its appearance. One community user reports they couldn't find a way to add custom fonts, which is consistent with no evidenced support.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can customize the font, colors, and cursor appearance of my terminal and persist the settings
